definitions.gloss: place to go; somewhere to turn
definitions.explanation: A place where a person or thing can go or be put. Almost always negative: {行|ゆ}き{場|ば}がない (to have nowhere to go), said of people, animals, goods or waste, and of feelings with no outlet ({行|ゆ}き{場|ば}のない{怒|いか}り).

examples.japanese: {行|ゆ}き{場|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt anger with no outlet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧{行|ゆ}き{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくした⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開放|かいほう}→開放：00445_kaihou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The gym was opened for people who had lost their homes and had nowhere to go.

notes:
Also read いきば, with the same meaning; ゆきば is a little more written.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {行|ゆ}き{場|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have nowhere to go
- {行|ゆ}き{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ / なくす: to be left with nowhere to go
- {行|ゆ}き{場|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧: feelings with no outlet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{居場所|いばしょ}→居場所：12366_ibasho⟧: a place where one belongs or is
- ⟦{逃|に}げ{場|ば}→逃げ場：32812_nigeba⟧: a place to escape to
